import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 4.6

by V. A. Artamonov

(P. Hall). Are the projective groups in the variety of metabelian groups
free?

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«4.6»

universe u

/-- A group is metabelian if its second derived subgroup is trivial. -/
def IsMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥

/-- A metabelian group is projective in the variety of metabelian groups if every
surjective homomorphism from a metabelian group onto it has a homomorphic section. -/
def IsProjectiveMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  IsMetabelian G ∧
    ∀ (E : Type u) [Group E], IsMetabelian E → ∀ e : E →* G,
      Function.Surjective e → ∃ s : G →* E, e.comp s = MonoidHom.id G

/-- A metabelian group is free in the variety of metabelian groups if it has a basis
such that every map from that basis to any metabelian group extends uniquely to a
group homomorphism. -/
def IsFreeMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  IsMetabelian G ∧
    ∃ (X : Type u) (ι : X → G),
      ∀ (H : Type u) [Group H], IsMetabelian H → ∀ f : X → H,
        ∃! F : G →* H, ∀ x, F (ι x) = f x

/--
(P. Hall). Are all projective groups in the variety of metabelian groups
free in that variety? Here both projectivity and freeness are relative to the
metabelian variety, and no finite-generation assumption is made.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«4.6» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (G : Type u) [Group G], IsProjectiveMetabelian G → IsFreeMetabelian G := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«4.6»
modeling_decisions: Metabelian groups are encoded by `derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥`, i.e. the second derived subgroup is trivial.

Projectivity is encoded by the equivalent splitting condition specified in the decomposition: every surjective homomorphism from a metabelian group onto the given metabelian group admits a homomorphic section.

Relative freeness is encoded by its universal property: there is an arbitrary, potentially infinite basis type such that every map from the basis into any metabelian group extends uniquely to a group homomorphism.
All group and basis types live in one arbitrary universe `u`, matching Mathlib's standard same-universe treatment of free groups while retaining universe-polymorphic and non-finitely-generated scope.

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 4.6

by V. A. Artamonov

(P. Hall). Are the projective groups in the variety of metabelian groups free?

A group $G$ is *metabelian* if its derived subgroup $G'$ is abelian, i.e. $G'' = 1$.
The metabelian groups form a variety of groups. A group $P$ is *projective* in this
variety if it is metabelian and every homomorphism $P \to B$ into a metabelian group $B$
lifts along every surjective homomorphism $A \to B$ of metabelian groups; equivalently,
$P$ is a retract of a free metabelian group. "Free" means free in the variety, i.e.
isomorphic to a *free metabelian group* $F/F''$ for an (absolutely) free group $F$ of
arbitrary rank. (An absolutely free group of rank at least $2$ is not metabelian.)

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«4.6»

universe u

/-- A group $G$ is *metabelian* if its derived subgroup $G'$ is abelian, i.e. $G'' = 1$:
the second term of the derived series of $G$ is trivial. -/
def IsMetabelian (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop :=
  derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥

/-- A group $G$ is *free metabelian*, i.e. free in the variety of metabelian groups, if it is
isomorphic to $F/F''$ for some absolutely free group $F$ (of any rank, possibly zero or
infinite). -/
def IsFreeMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ X : Type u, Nonempty (G ≃* FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2)

/-- A group $P$ is *projective in the variety of metabelian groups* if it is metabelian and
for every surjective homomorphism $f \colon A \to B$ of metabelian groups and every
homomorphism $g \colon P \to B$ there is a homomorphism $h \colon P \to A$ with
$f \circ h = g$. Equivalently, $P$ is a retract of a free metabelian group. -/
def IsProjectiveMetabelian (P : Type u) [Group P] : Prop :=
  IsMetabelian P ∧
    ∀ (A B : Type u) [Group A] [Group B], IsMetabelian A → IsMetabelian B →
      ∀ f : A →* B, Function.Surjective f → ∀ g : P →* B, ∃ h : P →* A, f.comp h = g

/-- Are the projective groups in the variety of metabelian groups free?

That is, is every group that is projective in the variety of metabelian groups a free
metabelian group $F/F''$ (of some, not necessarily finite, rank)? -/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«4.6» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G], IsProjectiveMetabelian G → IsFreeMetabelian G := by
  sorry

/-- Every abelian group is metabelian. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isMetabelian_of_commGroup (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] : IsMetabelian G := by
  have : commutator G = ⊥ := (commutator_eq_bot_iff_center_eq_top G).mpr CommGroup.center_eq_top
  simp [IsMetabelian, derivedSeries_succ, this]

/-- A homomorphic image of a metabelian group is metabelian. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem IsMetabelian.of_surjective {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] (hG : IsMetabelian G)
    {f : G →* H} (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsMetabelian H := by
  rw [IsMetabelian, ← map_derivedSeries_eq hf, hG, Subgroup.map_bot]

/-- The group $F/F''$ is free metabelian, for $F$ the free group on $X$. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem isFreeMetabelian_quotient (X : Type u) :
    IsFreeMetabelian (FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2) :=
  ⟨X, ⟨MulEquiv.refl _⟩⟩

/-- A free metabelian group is metabelian. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem IsFreeMetabelian.isMetabelian {G : Type u} [Group G] (h : IsFreeMetabelian G) :
    IsMetabelian G := by
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h
  have : IsMetabelian (FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2) := by
    rw [IsMetabelian, ← map_derivedSeries_eq (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _),
      QuotientGroup.map_mk'_self]
  exact this.of_surjective (f := e.symm.toMonoidHom) e.symm.surjective

/-- A free metabelian group is projective in the variety of metabelian groups. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem IsFreeMetabelian.isProjectiveMetabelian {G : Type u} [Group G]
    (h : IsFreeMetabelian G) : IsProjectiveMetabelian G := by
  refine ⟨h.isMetabelian, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h
  intro A B _ _ hA _ f hf g
  set N := derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2
  choose a ha using fun x : X => hf (g (e.symm (QuotientGroup.mk (FreeGroup.of x))))
  have hker : N ≤ (FreeGroup.lift a).ker := by
    rw [← Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff, ← le_bot_iff, ← hA]
    exact map_derivedSeries_le_derivedSeries _ 2
  refine ⟨(QuotientGroup.lift N (FreeGroup.lift a) hker).comp e, ?_⟩
  have : f.comp (QuotientGroup.lift N (FreeGroup.lift a) hker) = g.comp e.symm := by
    refine QuotientGroup.monoidHom_ext N (FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun x => ?_)
    simpa using ha x
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun this (e x)
  rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MonoidHom.comp_apply] at h2
  simpa using h2

end Kourovka.«4.6»
attempts.decomposition_objections: None. The single-slot decomposition and its notes (universal quantifier over all ranks; 'projective' in the variety; 'free' meaning relatively free F/F'') match my reading of the notebook statement.
modeling_decisions: 'Projective' is formalized by the lifting property against *surjective* homomorphisms between metabelian groups (the group-theoretic definition used by Hall/Neumann/Artamonov), rather than against categorical epimorphisms in the full subcategory of metabelian groups. This matches the decomposition notes ('every epimorphism from a metabelian group onto it splits' / 'retract of a free metabelian group'), and the two formulations (lifting property vs. retract of free) are equivalent by the standard pullback argument.

The lifting property in `IsProjectiveMetabelian` quantifies over test groups `A B` in the same universe as `P` (here `Type`). This is mathematically harmless: the lifting property against all metabelian groups is equivalent to being a retract of the free metabelian group on the underlying set of `P`, which lives in the same universe.

`IsMetabelian P` is included as a conjunct of `IsProjectiveMetabelian P` so that the group is required to lie in the variety; without it, absolutely free groups of rank ≥ 2 would satisfy the lifting property but are not metabelian.

`IsFreeMetabelian` uses an explicit isomorphism with `FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2` with `X : Type u`. Since any basis of a free metabelian group in `Type` has cardinality ≤ |G|, restricting `X` to the same universe loses nothing. Rank 0 (trivial group) counts as free, matching the usual convention and the fact that the trivial group is projective.

`IsMetabelian` requires `IsMetabelian B` in the definition of projectivity even though it follows from `IsMetabelian A` and surjectivity of `f`; this redundancy keeps the definition literally 'in the variety' and is harmless.

Extra API/test lemmas (abelian ⇒ metabelian; images of metabelian groups are metabelian; F/F'' is free metabelian; free metabelian ⇒ metabelian ⇒ projective) are included with full proofs, per the repository's request to add basic API tests for bespoke definitions. They also confirm the question is not vacuous: every free metabelian group is projective, so `answer(True)` is a genuine 'yes'.

  derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥

attribute [local instance] derivedSeries_normal

/-- The free metabelian group on `α`: the quotient `F/F''` of the free group `F` on `α` by
the second term of its derived series. -/
abbrev FreeMetabelianGroup (α : Type*) : Type _ :=

a metabelian group onto $G$ splits, or again, $G$ is a retract of a free metabelian group.

"Free" refers to freeness in the variety: the free metabelian group on a set $X$ is
$F/F''$, where $F$ is the free group on $X$. (An absolutely free group of rank at least $2$ is
not metabelian.) The question is asked for all metabelian groups, not only finitely generated
ones.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)

def IsMetabelian (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop :=
  derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥

/-- The *free metabelian group* on `α`: the quotient $F/F''$ of the free group $F$ on `α` by
its second derived subgroup. This is the relatively free group on `α` in the variety of
metabelian groups. -/
abbrev FreeMetabelianGroup (α : Type*) : Type _ :=
  FreeGroup α ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup α) 2

metabelian group $F/F''$ on some set. -/
def IsFreeMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ α : Type u, Nonempty (G ≃* FreeMetabelianGroup α)

/-- A group $G$ is *projective in the variety of metabelian groups* if it is metabelian and
has the lifting property with respect to surjective homomorphisms of metabelian groups:
for every surjective homomorphism $\pi \colon H \to K$ of metabelian groups and every
homomorphism $f \colon G \to K$ there is a homomorphism $g \colon G \to H$ with
$\pi \circ g = f$. -/
def IsProjectiveMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  IsMetabelian G ∧
    ∀ (H K : Type u) [Group H] [Group K], IsMetabelian H → IsMetabelian K →
      ∀ (π : H →* K) (f : G →* K), Function.Surjective π → ∃ g : G →* H, π.comp g = f

universe u

namespace Kourovka.«4.6»

/-- A group $G$ is metabelian if its second derived subgroup $G'' = [[G, G], [G, G]]$ is trivial,
i.e. the derived subgroup $G' = [G, G]$ is abelian. -/
def IsMetabelian (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop :=
  derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥

/-- A group $G$ is free metabelian (free in the variety of metabelian groups) if it is isomorphic
to $F/F''$ for some free group $F$, where $F''$ is the second derived subgroup of $F$.
As in `IsFreeGroup`, the set of free generators is taken in the same universe as $G$. -/
def IsFreeMetabelian (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ X : Type u, Nonempty (G ≃* FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2)

/-- A group $P$ is projective in the variety of metabelian groups if $P$ is metabelian and every
surjective homomorphism $f \colon G \to P$ from a metabelian group $G$ splits, i.e. there is a
homomorphism $s \colon P \to G$ with $f \circ s = \mathrm{id}_P$. Equivalently, $P$ is a retract
of a free metabelian group. -/
def IsProjectiveMetabelian (P : Type u) [Group P] : Prop :=
  IsMetabelian P ∧ ∀ (G : Type u) [Group G], IsMetabelian G →
    ∀ f : G →* P, Function.Surjective f → ∃ s : P →* G, f.comp s = MonoidHom.id P

(P. Hall). Are the projective groups in the variety of metabelian groups free?

That is, is every projective group in the variety of metabelian groups a free metabelian
group, i.e. isomorphic to $F/F''$ for some free group $F$?

  simp [IsMetabelian, derivedSeries_succ, h]

theorem IsMetabelian.of_mulEquiv {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] (e : G ≃* H)

  unfold IsMetabelian at *
  rw [← map_derivedSeries_eq (f := e.symm.toMonoidHom) e.symm.surjective 2, hH, Subgroup.map_bot]

  unfold IsMetabelian
  rw [← map_derivedSeries_eq (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _) 2, QuotientGroup.map_mk'_self]

  exact IsMetabelian.of_mulEquiv e (isMetabelian_freeGroup_quotient X)

easy direction of the question. -/

  refine ⟨hG.isMetabelian, fun H _ hH f hf => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hG

  have key : f.comp (FreeGroup.lift g) = e.symm.toMonoidHom.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' _) :=

    MonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_⟩

  have hw' := DFunLike.congr_fun key w
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply] at hw'
  rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, ← hw,

attempts.decomposition_objections: None. The single-slot decomposition and its notes (universal quantifier over all metabelian groups of any rank; projective = projective object in the variety; free = relatively free) match my reading of the source.
modeling_decisions: 'Projective' is defined via splitting of surjective homomorphisms onto P from metabelian groups (with P itself required metabelian), not via `CategoryTheory.Projective` in a subcategory of `Grp`; this matches the variety-of-groups definition and is equivalent to the lifting property (pullback inside the variety) and to being a retract of a free metabelian group.

'Free' is read as relatively free (free metabelian, F/F''), not absolutely free, per the decomposition notes; formalized concretely as isomorphism to `FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2` rather than via the universal property.

Universe choices: the main theorem quantifies over `P : Type` (repository idiom); `IsFreeMetabelian` takes generators in the same universe as G (as Mathlib's `IsFreeGroup` does; harmless since |X| ≤ |F/F''|), and `IsProjectiveMetabelian` quantifies the source group over the same universe as P (harmless since the free metabelian group on P's underlying set is in that universe, so splitting it already makes P a retract of a free metabelian group).
Added proved `@[category API]` lemmas as sanity checks of the bespoke definitions, including the easy direction free metabelian ⇒ projective metabelian; the main theorem is the only `sorry`.

new_definitions.closest_existing_considered: `IsSolvable G` (∃ n, derivedSeries G n = ⊥) and `derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥` used directly; `IsMulCommutative (commutator G)` would also work but is less direct.
new_definitions.name: Kourovka.«4.6».IsMetabelian
new_definitions.why_needed: Mathlib has `derivedSeries` and `IsSolvable` but no predicate for metabelian groups (second derived subgroup trivial).

new_definitions.closest_existing_considered: `IsFreeGroup` / `FreeGroupBasis` (absolutely free, wrong notion); no relatively free group notion exists in Mathlib or FormalConjecturesForMathlib.
new_definitions.name: Kourovka.«4.6».IsFreeMetabelian
new_definitions.why_needed: Mathlib's `IsFreeGroup` is absolute freeness; the problem needs freeness relative to the variety of metabelian groups, i.e. G ≅ F/F'' for a free group F. Defined as `∃ X : Type u, Nonempty (G ≃* FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2)`, mirroring `IsFreeGroup`'s shape.

new_definitions.closest_existing_considered: `CategoryTheory.Projective` applied to a full subcategory of `Grp` on metabelian objects; rejected because categorical projectivity is relative to categorical epimorphisms, whose surjectivity in this variety would be an extra unverified assumption, while the group-theoretic literature defines projectivity via surjective homomorphisms.
new_definitions.name: Kourovka.«4.6».IsProjectiveMetabelian
new_definitions.why_needed: No notion of projective object in a variety of groups exists. Defined as: P is metabelian and every surjective hom from a metabelian group (in the same universe) onto P has a section. Equivalent to the lifting property along surjections and to being a retract of a free metabelian group.

kourovka.«4.6».why: Stated as `answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ (P : Type) [Group P], IsProjectiveMetabelian P → IsFreeMetabelian P`. Metabelian = `derivedSeries G 2 = ⊥` (G'' = 1); free in the variety = isomorphic to `FreeGroup X ⧸ derivedSeries (FreeGroup X) 2` (F/F''); projective in the variety = metabelian and every surjective homomorphism from a metabelian group onto P splits (equivalent to the lifting property and to being a retract of a free metabelian group). No rank restriction, matching the implicit universal quantifier. Mathlib/repo have no notion of metabelian, relatively free, or projective-in-a-variety, so three bespoke problem-local definitions were added, with proved API lemmas (including the easy direction: free metabelian ⇒ projective).
